descriptions.notStarted: I hear that #p1012101# is very sick...
descriptions.inProgress: I met this girl named Maya at the old, raggedy townstreet of Henesys. She's been suffering from illness for a long time, so she doesn't look too well to even live a normal life. #bWeird Medicine#k... what a strange name, and she said she'll get a little bit better by taking that... I better go to Lith Harbor and see this guy Teo...
descriptions.completed: Maya wanted me to go see Teo of Lith Harbor, so I did just that. He promised to give me the Weird Medicine only after I get him a Sparkling Rock.
